plumestweaks.configuration.title: Plume's Tweaks Configs
plumestweaks.configuration.clearItemsRad: Default radius (blocks) for the /clearitems command. Range: 1~100
plumestweaks.configuration.autoXaeroWayp: Automatically add a Xaero waypoint when Nature's/Explorer's Compass finds a target. Requires Xaero's Minimap/World Map on the client
plumestweaks.configuration.freeCrossDime: Master switch: allow non-OP players to use the unbanned commands below. Disabling it turns off all command switches
plumestweaks.configuration.freeExecute.t: Allow non-OP players to run /execute (and subcommands requiring level <= 2). Requires the master switch
plumestweaks.configuration.freeFtbQuests: Allow non-OP players to use FTB Quests /ftbquests (all subcommands). Requires the master switch
plumestweaks.configuration.freePlace.too: Allow non-OP players to use /place. Requires the master switch
plumestweaks.configuration.freeCompassTe: Allow non-OP players to use the teleport button of Nature's/Explorer's Compass. When disabled, the original (cheat mode or OP) restriction is restored
